1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not substantially reduce viability of the embryos__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __without prior culturing of the embryos__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitation is performed for a duration of less than 1 hour__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __lysing cells in the shed cellular material through exposure to cold and then heat followed by agitation, wherein the cold temperature is below 0°C and the heat temperature is above 50°C__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __lysing cells in the shed cellular material through heating to a temperature above 50°C and agitation__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading__ enzyme __selected to disrupt cell walls while maintaining DNA integrity__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __from the shed cellular material using a purification method that concentrates DNA__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to isolate DNA-bound particles__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at a developmental stage prior to full maturation__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent state at reduced temperature__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without disrupting embryo viability__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __before germination of non-selected embryos__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __while discarding non-selected embryos__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using robotic or computational systems__.
